030package dev.visdb.seesaw.models;
031
032import java.util.Objects;
033
034/**
035 * An item that acts kind of like a standalone SSListItem.
036 *
037 * @param <K>
038 * @param <D>
039 * @param <D2>
040 */
041public class Item2<K, D, D2> {
042  private final K key;
043  private final D displayValue;
044  private final D2 d2;
045
046  /** Use this for D2 arg of constructor, if there is no D2. */
047  public static final Object NO_D2 = new Object();
048
049  /**
050   * Create immutable item.
051   * @param key
052   * @param displayValue
053   * @param d2
054   */
055  public Item2(K key, D displayValue, D2 d2) {
056    this.key = key;
057    this.displayValue = displayValue;
058    this.d2 = d2;
059  }
060
061  /**
062   * Create immutable item which does not have a d2.
063   * @param key
064   * @param displayValue
065   */
066  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
067  Item2(K key, D displayValue) {
068    this(key, displayValue, (D2) NO_D2);
069  }
070
071  //
072  // It seems this never worked. Note the "this(null, null, null);".
073  // ComboBox2.getChosenItem(fnConstructItem) is pretty good.
074  //
075  // /**
076  //  * Create immutable item based on SSListItem.
077  //  * @param listItem
078  //  * @param hasD2
079  //  */
080  // @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
081  // Item2(SSListItem listItem, boolean hasD2) {
082  //   // li = (ListItem0)listItem;
083  //   // key = (K)li.getElem(OptionMappingSwingModel.KEY_IDX);
084  //   // displayValue = (D)li.getElem(OptionMappingSwingModel.DISP_IDX);
085  //   // handle D2
086  //   this(null, null, null);
087  // }
088
089  /**
090   * key getter.
091   * @return
092   */
093  public K getKey() {
094    return key;
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * displayValue getter.
099   * @return
100   */
101  public D getDisplayValue() {
102    return displayValue;
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * d2 getter.
107   * Exception if does not have a d2
108   * @return
109   */
110  public D2 getD2() {
111    if (d2 == NO_D2)
112      throw new IllegalStateException("Item does not have d2");
113    return d2;
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Check if this has a d2
118   * @return true if there is a d2
119   */
120  public boolean hasD2() {
121    return d2 != NO_D2;
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * hashCode.
126   * @return
127   */
128  @Override
129  public int hashCode() {
130    int hash = 7;
131    hash = 67 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.key);
132    hash = 67 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.displayValue);
133    hash = 67 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.d2);
134    return hash;
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * equals.
139   * @param obj
140   * @return
141   */
142  @Override
143  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
144    if (this == obj)
145      return true;
146    if (obj == null)
147      return false;
148    if (getClass() != obj.getClass())
149      return false;
150                final Item2<?, ?, ?> other = (Item2<?, ?, ?>) obj;
151                if (!Objects.equals(this.key, other.key))
152                  return false;
153                if (!Objects.equals(this.displayValue, other.displayValue))
154                  return false;
155                return Objects.equals(this.d2, other.d2);
156  }
157}
